full_judgment: Moreover, while convicting the appellant the learned trial Court also taken into consideration of the fact of absconcion of the appellant after obtaining the bail and made a presumption of his guilt to that effect. In the case of Osman Gani Vs. State reported in 9 BLT (AD) 107 it was held that "the fact of absconcion by itself cannot be the only 'ground for conviction. Normally even an innocent person tries to keep out of the way if he learns of his false implication in a serious case reported to the police. It is a somewhat weak link in the circumstances for establishing the guilt of a person".
